findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_shyftoff_opportunities" is 1086 chars, far longer than this server's median (180). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_shyftoff_opportunities, get_contact · Private data: get_recruiter_faq, get_shyftoff_opportunities, check_eligibility, plan_staffing, get_contact · Public sink: get_shyftoff_opportunities, plan_staffing, get_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_shyftoff_opportunities, get_contact · Private data: get_recruiter_faq, get_shyftoff_opportunities, check_eligibility, plan_staffing, get_contact · Public sink: get_shyftoff_opportunities, plan_staffing, get_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
